project.name: NTPC Warranty Management System
project.description: A full-stack web application for managing computer equipment warranty tickets. Built with React 18, Ant Design, Express.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.

nodes.name: CI
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI pipeline that runs on push and pull_request events. It checks out code, installs Node.js 20 with npm dependencies, validates and generates the Prisma client, runs tests, and builds the frontend.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes node_modules, dist, .git, .env, logs, test files, API uploads/backups, and pgdata from Docker build context to keep images small and avoid leaking secrets.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive project documentation (734 lines) covering architecture, tech stack, directory structure, patterns, UI/UX, strengths/weaknesses, installation guides, and full API reference for the NTPC Warranty Management System.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Orchestration file defining 4 services: postgres-db (PostgreSQL 15), backend-api (Node.js Express), frontend-web (Nginx serving React SPA), and cloudflare-quick-tunnel (Cloudflare tunnel for public access). Uses bridge network, health checks, and persistent volumes.

nodes.name: postgres-db
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL 15 Alpine container with persistent volume at ./pgdata, port mapped 5435:5432, health check via pg_isready, and environment variables for credentials and timezone.

nodes.name: backend-api
nodes.summary: Node.js Express API service built from api.Dockerfile, depends on postgres-db. Exposes port 3003, uses DATABASE_URL for Prisma, mounts uploads and backups volumes, health checked via /api/health endpoint.

nodes.name: frontend-web
nodes.summary: Nginx-based frontend service built from web.Dockerfile, serving the React SPA on port 8888:80. Depends on healthy backend-api, health checked via wget to localhost.

nodes.name: cloudflare-quick-tunnel
nodes.summary: Cloudflare tunnel service exposing the frontend-web via trycloudflare.com for public HTTPS access without a static domain. Depends on frontend-web.

nodes.name: get-tunnel.bat
nodes.summary: Windows batch script that extracts the Cloudflare Quick Tunnel URL from docker logs of ntpc-cloudflare-quick-tunnel container using PowerShell regex, copies it to clipboard, and opens it in the default browser.

nodes.name: get-tunnel.sh
nodes.summary: Linux/macOS shell script that extracts the Cloudflare Quick Tunnel URL from docker logs of ntpc-cloudflare-quick-tunnel container using grep regex, displays it, and attempts clipboard copy via pbcopy or xclip.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite SPA entry point with Vietnamese language, SEO meta tags for warranty lookup, SVG wrench emoji favicon, and mounts React app at #root via /src/main.jsx.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root package config for ntpc-warranty v3.0.0. Defines dev/build/test scripts using Vite, concurrently runs Express API + Vite dev server. Key dependencies: React 18, antd 5, Prisma, Express, i18next, zod, react-hook-form, xlsx.

nodes.name: Vietnamese Messages Locale
nodes.summary: Vietnamese i18n message strings for user-facing notifications. Contains 4 sections: success (create/update/delete/copy confirmations), error (load/save/not-found/copy failures), confirm (delete/return/cancel confirmations), and phieu (ticket creation with interpolation placeholder {{so}}). 23 lines total.

nodes.name: Vietnamese Navigation Locale
nodes.summary: Vietnamese i18n navigation strings. Contains 3 sections: page (page titles for dashboard, warranty tickets, customers, staff, suppliers, statistics, import/export, tracking), menu (sidebar menu labels mirroring page names), and action (switch staff, open menu, shortcuts). 29 lines total.

nodes.name: Vietnamese Print Template Locale
nodes.summary: Vietnamese i18n strings for printable warranty receipt/ticket. Contains 41 top-level keys covering company info (name, address, tax, hotline, website), receipt layout fields (document number, customer/product/warranty sections, QR scan), and template placeholders for signatures. Includes interpolation for warranty progress ({{remaining}}/{{total}} months). 46 lines.

nodes.name: Vietnamese Status Labels Locale
nodes.summary: Vietnamese i18n strings for status enums used across the app. Contains 3 sections: trangThai (ticket statuses: received, processing, done, canceled), loaiXuLy (handling types: warranty, service repair, replacement, other), and baoHanh (warranty durations: 1/3/12/24/36/60 months, custom). 25 lines.

nodes.name: Vietnamese UI Strings Locale
nodes.summary: The largest Vietnamese i18n file (594 lines, 24 sections). Covers the entire UI: app branding, buttons, common labels, table headers, form fields, admin password gate, error boundary, keyboard shortcuts, staff picker, search, notifications, 404 page, public warranty tracking (with result display), admin pages for customers/warranty list/staff/statistics/dashboard/create-warranty/import-export/suppliers, and an AI assistant module with thought/answer prompts. Heavy use of interpolation placeholders ({{count}}, {{date}}, {{code}}, etc.).

nodes.name: Vietnamese Validation Messages Locale
nodes.summary: Vietnamese i18n validation error messages. 14 flat keys covering required-field errors (customer, product name, serial, received issue, warranty term, return date, staff), format validations (invalid phone, invalid email, invalid date), and business rules (document number already exists, cost must be positive/non-negative). 16 lines.

nodes.label: .claude/settings.local.json
nodes.description: Claude Code local settings defining allowed Bash permissions (npm, node, python).

nodes.label: .understandignore
nodes.description: Gitignore-style patterns for excluding files/dirs from codebase analysis (env, backups, uploads, tests).

nodes.label: api.Dockerfile
nodes.description: Docker build for the Express.js API backend. Uses node:20-alpine, installs Prisma dependencies, generates Prisma Client, copies api/ and src/ directories, exposes port 3003.

nodes.label: api/lib/db.js
nodes.description: Database abstraction layer bridging JSON file fallback and PostgreSQL via Prisma. Provides readDb, writeDb, getCollection, setCollection, addToCollection, autoSelfHealingSync, syncLocalBackup. Normalizes nhanVien rows and supplier logs.

nodes.label: api/lib/auth.js
nodes.description: Authentication and authorization library. Implements JWT-based session cookies (HMAC-SHA256), password hashing (scrypt), login rate limiting, middleware (attachUser, requireAuth, requireRole), and staff management (findActiveStaff, authenticateStaff, ensureAuthState).

nodes.label: api/lib/audit.js
nodes.description: Audit logging utility. Exports writeAuditLog which records actor info (maNV, tenNV, IP, user-agent), action, entity, entityId, summary, and before/after snapshots to the AuditLog table via Prisma.

nodes.label: api/lib/backup.js
nodes.description: Comprehensive backup/restore system. Supports minute/hourly/daily/monthly/manual/uploaded backup types with retention policies. Handles JSON snapshots, asset bundles (tgz), SHA-256 checksums, deduplication via hard links, restore drills, and scheduled cleanup via startBackupScheduler.

nodes.label: api/lib/customerMaster.js
nodes.description: Customer master data builder. Exports buildCustomerMasterFromWarranties which aggregates warranty records into a deduplicated customer list with auto-generated codes (KH00001 format), tracking last seen date and active status.

nodes.label: api/lib/customers.js
nodes.description: Customer utility functions for warranty lookups. Provides customer key generation, warranty-customer association, customer aggregation stats, name suggestions, and customer search by query/key.

nodes.label: api/lib/restore_drill.js
nodes.description: Restore drill/test utility. Runs a full restore simulation inside a Prisma transaction: deletes all data, re-inserts from backup JSON, validates counts, then rolls back. Exports runRestoreDrill.

nodes.label: api/lib/validators.js
nodes.description: Zod validation schemas for warranty, status updates, return processing, exchange/return, supplier, supplier send, and supplier return operations.

nodes.label: api/routes/auth.js
nodes.description: Express router for /api/auth endpoints. Provides POST /login, POST /logout, GET /me, POST /change-password. Uses auth middleware and db read/write.

nodes.label: api/routes/backups.js
nodes.description: Express router for /api/admin/backups endpoints. Provides backup CRUD operations: list, create, view, download, restore, delete, upload, history, status, metadata. Logs actions via writeAuditLog.

nodes.label: api/routes/customers.js
nodes.description: Express router for /api/customers endpoints. Provides customer list, search, detail, update, and name suggestions. Integrates customer master data from warranties.

nodes.label: api/routes/nhanVien.js
nodes.description: Express router for /api/nhan-vien (staff) endpoints. Provides staff listing, credential verification, creation, update, and deactivation. Uses Prisma directly for CRUD.

nodes.label: api/routes/public.js
nodes.description: Express router for /api/public endpoints (no auth required). Provides public warranty lookup by phone/code with rate limiting. Includes Vietnamese text normalization, history timeline display, and exchange/return formatting.

nodes.label: api/routes/stats.js
nodes.description: Express router for /api/stats endpoints. Provides dashboard summary (total, processing, returned today, near deadline), daily stats, and monthly trends from warranty data.

nodes.label: api/routes/suppliers.js
nodes.description: Express router for /api/suppliers endpoints. Manages supplier CRUD, auto-generates supplier codes (NCC00001 format), and validates via Zod supplierSchema. Uses Prisma and audit logging.

nodes.label: api/routes/warranties.js
nodes.description: Main warranty routes (1557 lines, largest route file). Handles full warranty lifecycle: create, list with filtering/sorting/pagination, detail, update, status transitions, return processing, exchange/return, supplier send/return, soft delete, file attachments (DataURL to disk), Excel import/export, customer auto-linking, and history timeline generation.

nodes.label: api/routes/warranties.js.bak-customers-master
nodes.description: Backup of warranties.js before customer master refactoring. Contains earlier version of warranty routes.

nodes.label: api/seedData.js
nodes.description: Seed data generator for initial database population. Exports arrays of sample warranty tickets and staff (nhanVien) with realistic Vietnamese data, dates, statuses, and history entries.

nodes.label: api/server.js
nodes.description: Main Express.js API server entry point. Configures CORS (LAN-aware), helmet security, JSON body parsing (50MB limit), static file serving for uploads. Imports all route modules, applies auth middleware chain, seeds database on startup, provides /api/health endpoint with DB and filesystem checks.

nodes.label: React i18next Rollout Plan
nodes.description: Detailed 10-task implementation plan for migrating the React frontend to i18next internationalization. Covers dependency installation, foundation setup, constants/validation migration, component migration, cleanup, and browser verification.

nodes.label: React i18next Rollout Design
nodes.description: Design specification for React i18next rollout. Defines goals, scope, i18n architecture (react-i18next + i18next-browser-languagedetector), namespace rules, migration strategy, component patterns, verification steps, and risk controls.

nodes.label: filebaohanh.xlsx
nodes.description: Excel spreadsheet containing warranty ticket data (506 rows). Likely source for Excel import feature in warranty management.

nodes.label: fixdates.cjs
nodes.description: One-off utility script to fix malformed date strings (ngayNhan, ngayHenTra, ngayMua) in api/db.json. Converts DD/MM/YYYY to ISO format.

nodes.label: nginx.conf
nodes.description: Nginx reverse proxy configuration for Docker deployment. Serves React SPA static files and proxies /api requests to backend-api:3003. Configures 50MB upload limit and 300s timeouts.

nodes.label: nccdemo.html
nodes.description: HTML template for supplier warranty dispatch slip (Phiếu gửi bảo hành/sửa chữa). Half-A4 page layout with print-optimized CSS for sending items to suppliers.

nodes.label: 20260525_add_audit_indexes
nodes.description: Prisma migration adding audit_logs table and 23 performance indexes across nhan_vien, suppliers, supplier_logs, warranties, and audit_logs tables.

nodes.label: schema.prisma
nodes.description: Prisma ORM schema defining the PostgreSQL database for the NTPC warranty system. Models: NhanVien (staff), Supplier, SupplierLog, Warranty (core entity), AuditLog. Uses PostgreSQL with JSON fields for flexible data (attachments, history, doiTra).

nodes.label: pgdata-before-pg_resetwal-20260525-175610.tgz
nodes.description: Compressed PostgreSQL data directory backup taken before pg_resetwal operation on 2026-05-25. Disaster recovery artifact.

nodes.label: pgdata backup SHA256 checksum
nodes.description: SHA-256 checksum file for verifying integrity of the pgdata backup archive.

nodes.label: scratch/audit_history.js
nodes.description: Scratch/debug script to inspect warranty audit history from PostgreSQL via Prisma. Filters out supplier-related noise entries using isSupplierNoise() helper.

nodes.label: scratch/backfill_supplier_names.js
nodes.description: Scratch script to backfill empty supplierName fields in SupplierLog records by matching supplierId to Supplier table.

nodes.label: scratch/check_timeline.js
nodes.description: Scratch script to debug timeline rendering for a specific warranty ticket (23052026NTPC9). Uses both Prisma and readDb to compare data sources and calls buildInternalHistoryTimeline.

nodes.label: scratch/inspect_supplier_logs.js
nodes.description: Scratch script to list all SupplierLog records from PostgreSQL for debugging.

nodes.label: scratch/inspect_users.js
nodes.description: Scratch script to inspect NhanVien (staff) records from PostgreSQL, showing hashed passwords and verifying auth state.

nodes.label: scratch/inspect_warranties.js
nodes.description: Scratch script to list all active (non-deleted) Warranty records from PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: scratch/reset_passwords_v2.js
nodes.description: Scratch script v2 to reset all NhanVien passwords to a hardcoded value using hashPassword from auth module.

nodes.label: scratch/reset_passwords.js
nodes.description: Scratch script to reset all NhanVien passwords to a hardcoded value using hashPassword from auth module.

nodes.label: scratch/verify_recovery.js
nodes.description: Scratch script to verify two-way sync and self-healing recovery features by reading DB, modifying data, and testing syncLocalBackup/autoSelfHealingSync.

nodes.label: scripts/bootstrap-auth.mjs
nodes.description: Bootstrap script to ensure auth state is initialized. Loads .env, reads DB, calls ensureAuthState(), writes back, and dumps NhanVien auth info.

nodes.label: scripts/cleanup-current-data.mjs
nodes.description: Data cleanup script that creates a safety backup then removes non-essential warranty records from db.json, keeping only a whitelist of specific tickets.

nodes.label: scripts/cleanup-orphan-uploads.js
nodes.description: Script to find and optionally delete orphaned upload files in api/uploads/warranties/ that are no longer referenced by any warranty record in db.json.

nodes.label: scripts/migrate_fix_mojibake_notes.py
nodes.description: Python migration script to fix mojibake (corrupted Vietnamese encoding) in warranty history notes within api/db.json. Creates timestamped backup before modification.

nodes.label: scripts/migrate_fix_priority_mojibake_notes.py
nodes.description: Python migration script to fix mojibake specifically in priority-related notes (e.g., 'Đánh dấu ưu tiên') within api/db.json.

nodes.label: scripts/migrateData.js
nodes.description: Data migration script to transfer warranty, customer, supplier, and staff records from api/db.json (JSON file DB) to PostgreSQL via Prisma. Handles data normalization and type conversion.

nodes.label: App.jsx
nodes.description: Main React application component. Configures routing (React Router v6), theming (antd ConfigProvider with Vietnamese locale), authentication guards (RequireStaff, RequireAdminRole), and lazy-loads all page components. Routes: /tra-cuu (customer lookup), /admin/* (dashboard, warranty CRUD, customer info, staff management, suppliers, statistics, import/export).

nodes.label: BackupRestorePanel
nodes.description: Admin panel for backup and restore operations. Supports creating manual backups, listing/viewing/restoring/deleting backups, uploading JSON backups and asset packages (images), editing backup metadata (pin/note), and viewing backup/restore history. Uses backupService API.

nodes.label: AiAssistant
nodes.description: AI-powered chat assistant component using @ant-design/x. Provides interactive help including: warranty lookup by code (NTPC format), statistics summary, staff listing, warranty policy info, and contact details. Uses Bubble, Sender, Prompts, ThoughtChain from ant-design-x. Available to both customers and staff with role-based prompt options.

nodes.label: ChangePasswordModal.jsx
nodes.description: Modal component for changing user password. Uses authService.changePassword API, antd Form, and i18n translations.

nodes.label: CustomerPickerModal.jsx
nodes.description: Modal for searching and selecting customers from a list. Filters by name, phone, and address. Uses antd List and Modal.

nodes.label: ErrorBoundary.jsx
nodes.description: React error boundary class component. Catches rendering errors and shows a Result UI with reload option. Uses i18n for translations.

nodes.label: FloatingZalo.jsx
nodes.description: Draggable floating Zalo chat button with mobile/desktop support. Handles touch/mouse drag, trash zone deletion, and deep-linking to Zalo app/web.

nodes.label: ShortcutsModal.jsx
nodes.description: Modal displaying keyboard shortcuts table. Uses antd Modal/Table and i18n translations.

nodes.label: SkeletonCard.jsx
nodes.description: Loading skeleton placeholder card using antd Skeleton and Card components.

nodes.label: StaffPickerModal.jsx
nodes.description: Modal for selecting/switching staff accounts. Authenticates via useAuth login, with form validation and i18n support.

nodes.label: AdminLayout.jsx
nodes.description: Admin layout shell with collapsible sidebar and header. Manages mobile sider popup state. Composes AppSider and AppHeader.

nodes.label: AppHeader.jsx
nodes.description: Application header with breadcrumb navigation, global search trigger, notification bell, language switcher, theme toggle, staff picker, and change-password modal.

nodes.label: AppSider.jsx
nodes.description: Admin sidebar navigation with menu items, urgency badges for warranty items, and mobile/desktop responsive rendering.

nodes.label: CustomerLayout.jsx
nodes.description: Customer-facing layout with header, tab navigation, theme toggle, language switcher, Zalo floating button, and responsive mobile/desktop rendering.

nodes.label: GlobalSearch.jsx
nodes.description: Global search modal with debounced search across warranties. Displays results grouped by status with keyboard navigation. Integrates warrantyService and statusConfig.

nodes.label: NotificationBell.jsx
nodes.description: Notification bell with popover showing urgent/overdue warranty alerts. Uses useWarranties hook, urgency calculation, and StatusTag for display.

nodes.label: MobileStatusTag.jsx
nodes.description: Mobile-optimized warranty status tag using antd-mobile Tag with status colors from badgeConfig.

nodes.label: StatusTag.jsx
nodes.description: Desktop warranty status tag using antd Tag with colors from statusConfig.

nodes.label: WarrantyDetail.jsx
nodes.description: Large comprehensive warranty detail drawer with tabs for info, timeline, editing, status updates, file uploads, QR code, and customer/supplier management. Central component of the warranty workflow.

nodes.label: WarrantyPrint.jsx
nodes.description: Printable warranty card page with QR code. Loads warranty and supplier data, formats for printing via react-to-print.

nodes.label: WarrantyProgress.jsx
nodes.description: Warranty progress indicator using antd Progress bar. Shows completion percentage based on warranty dates.

nodes.label: badgeConfig.js
nodes.description: Badge color configuration for status and type indicators. Exports BADGE_COLORS, getStatusBadgeColor, and getBadgeColor functions.

nodes.label: routes.js
nodes.description: Application route constants. Exports ROUTES object with named route paths.

nodes.label: statusConfig.js
nodes.description: Warranty status configuration with status enum, labels, and color mappings. Imports i18n and badgeConfig.

nodes.label: warrantyOptions.js
nodes.description: Warranty form options configuration. Exports BAO_HANH_OPTIONS, LOAI_XU_LY_OPTIONS, and LOAI_XU_LY_LABELS with i18n support.

nodes.label: AuthContext.jsx
nodes.description: Authentication context provider. Manages current staff state, login/logout via authService, and provides useAuth hook. Persists staff in localStorage.

nodes.label: useDebounce.js
nodes.description: Custom hook that debounces a value by a configurable delay (default 300ms).

nodes.label: useIsMobile.js
nodes.description: Custom hook that tracks viewport width to determine mobile state. Listens to window resize events.

nodes.label: useKeyboardShortcuts.js
nodes.description: Custom React hook for global keyboard shortcuts. Handles Ctrl+N (new ticket), Ctrl+K (search focus), Ctrl+P (print), Escape (close drawer), and ? (show shortcuts). Uses useEffect to attach/detach keydown listener on window.

nodes.label: useTheme.js
nodes.description: Custom React hook for dark/light theme management. Persists theme to localStorage, syncs across tabs via storage events, and provides toggle function. Returns { isDark, toggle, theme } where theme is the antd theme config object.

nodes.label: useWarranties.js
nodes.description: Custom React hook for fetching warranty list data from the API. Manages loading, error, and data states. Uses useCallback for the fetch function and useEffect to trigger initial fetch. Returns { data, loading, error, refetch }.

nodes.label: i18n/index.js
nodes.description: i18next internationalization configuration. Sets Vietnamese (vi) as default and fallback language. Defines 6 namespaces: ui, status, messages, validation, print, nav. Imports locale JSON files from ./locales/vi/. Uses LanguageDetector and react-i18next plugins.

nodes.label: ui.json.bak-field-labels
nodes.description: Backup file of Vietnamese UI translation field labels. Contains 582 lines of translated UI strings. Not actively used by the application - serves as a reference/backup for the translation system.

nodes.label: axios.js
nodes.description: Axios HTTP client configuration. Creates an axios instance with baseURL '/api', 300s timeout, credentials enabled, and JSON content type. Includes response interceptor that handles 429 rate limiting errors.

nodes.label: zodSchemas.js
nodes.description: Zod validation schemas for warranty forms. Defines warrantyFormSchema with fields: khachHang, soDienThoai, diaChi, loaiPhieu, baoGiaSau, tenHang, soSeri, cauHinh, loiLucNhan, phuKien, chiPhi, baoHanh, loaiXuLy, ghiChu, ngayMua, ngayHenTra, maNhanVien. Uses i18n for validation messages.

nodes.label: main.jsx
nodes.description: Application entry point. Initializes React 18 with createRoot, imports i18n configuration, global CSS styles, and renders the App component inside React.StrictMode.

nodes.label: CreateWarranty.jsx
nodes.description: Admin page for creating new warranty tickets. Uses react-hook-form with zod validation. Features include: auto-generated next code, customer auto-complete with customerService.lookup, serial number duplicate warning, draft auto-save to localStorage, image attachment preview, and warranty date calculation using addBusinessDaysSkipSunday.

nodes.label: CustomerInfo.jsx
nodes.description: Admin page for customer management. Features: customer search with autocomplete suggestions, customer list table with filtering, customer detail drawer showing warranty history, customer editing (name, phone, address), customer deletion, assigning unassigned warranties to customers, date range and status filtering of warranty history.

nodes.label: Dashboard.jsx
nodes.description: Admin dashboard page. Displays summary statistics (total, in-progress, completed, waiting), recent warranty list, and timeline of recent activity. Uses nhanVienService, statsService, and warrantyService. Supports mobile view with antd-mobile components. Shows urgency indicators and due date warnings.

nodes.label: ImportExport.jsx
nodes.description: Admin page for importing/exporting warranty data. Supports Excel file upload with preview, column mapping, and batch import. Export options for all warranties or filtered results. Includes delete-all functionality and backup/restore panel via BackupRestorePanel component.

nodes.label: StaffManagement.jsx
nodes.description: Admin page for managing staff members. Features: list all staff, add new staff member, reset staff password, remove staff member. Uses nhanVienService and authService from warrantyService. Displays staff table with action buttons.

nodes.label: Statistics.jsx
nodes.description: Admin statistics page with charts. Displays warranty trends by date (bar/line chart), top products, and top customers. Uses @ant-design/charts for visualization. Supports period selection (last 7/30/90 days, this year, custom range). Adapts chart colors for dark/light theme via useTheme hook.

nodes.label: Suppliers.jsx
nodes.description: Admin page for supplier management. Features: list/create/update suppliers, toggle supplier active status, view supplier warranty assignments, send warranties to suppliers, track supplier repair status. Uses supplierService, warrantyService, and nhanVienService. Supports mobile view.

nodes.label: WarrantyList.jsx
nodes.description: Admin warranty list page - the main ticket management view. Features: paginated table with search, status/type/staff/due-date filtering, priority flag toggle, bulk actions, sort options, copy ticket ID, print, delete. Uses useDebounce and useIsMobile hooks. Opens WarrantyDetail drawer for individual tickets. Supports mobile view with antd-mobile components.

nodes.label: CustomerPortal.jsx
nodes.description: Customer-facing portal page. Allows customers to search for their warranty tickets by ticket number. Displays warranty status, progress tracking, and ticket details. Uses publicService for API calls. Supports dark/light theme toggle and mobile responsive view with antd-mobile components.

nodes.label: TrackingResult.jsx
nodes.description: Customer-facing warranty tracking result page. Displays detailed warranty ticket information including status steps, repair history timeline, equipment details, attachments, and customer info. Uses publicService for data fetching, useTheme for dark mode, and CSS modules for styling. Supports print functionality and mobile-responsive layout with antd-mobile components.

nodes.label: TrackingResult.module.css
nodes.description: CSS module for the TrackingResult page. Contains 1124 lines of scoped styles for the warranty tracking result view, including status step indicators, timeline styling, responsive breakpoints for mobile, print-specific styles, and dark mode adaptations.

nodes.label: Tracuu.jsx
nodes.description: Customer-facing warranty lookup page (Tra cứu = Search/Lookup). Allows customers to search for warranty tickets by ticket number or keywords. Shows search results list with status badges. Stores recent searches in localStorage. Uses publicService, useTheme hook, and getStatusBadgeColor. Supports mobile view with antd-mobile components.

nodes.label: NotFound.jsx
nodes.description: 404 Not Found page component. Displays a 404 result with translated title and buttons to navigate to home page or admin panel. Uses antd Result component, react-i18next for translations, and react-router-dom useNavigate.

nodes.label: backupService.js
nodes.description: Service module for database backup and restore operations. Exports backupService object with methods: status, list, history, create, restore, uploadRestore, uploadAssets, delete, view, metadata, downloadUrl, downloadAssetsUrl. All methods call the /api/admin/backups endpoints.

nodes.label: warrantyService.js
nodes.description: Central API service module exporting 7 service objects: warrantyService (CRUD, import/export, supplier logs, attachments, history), customerService (list, unassigned, suggest, lookup, update, delete), statsService (summary, byDate, topProducts, topCustomers), publicService (track, search), supplierService (CRUD, status, warranties), nhanVienService (CRUD, password), authService (login, logout, me, changePassword). All use the shared axios instance from lib/axios.js.

nodes.label: global.css
nodes.description: Global CSS stylesheet (4022 lines). Contains application-wide styles including CSS custom properties for theming (light/dark mode), typography, layout, component overrides for antd and antd-mobile, responsive breakpoints, print styles, animation keyframes, loading indicators, and utility classes.

nodes.label: print.css
nodes.description: Print-specific CSS stylesheet. Contains @media print rules that optimize the warranty ticket view for printing, hiding navigation elements, adjusting layout, and ensuring proper page breaks.

nodes.label: antdTheme.js
nodes.description: Ant Design theme configuration with light and dark variants, Vietnamese-compatible font stack, and component-level overrides for Table, Menu, Card, Button, Statistic.

nodes.label: copy.js
nodes.description: Clipboard copy utility. Uses navigator.clipboard API with fallback to textarea-based copy for older browsers.

nodes.label: dateHelpers.js
nodes.description: Date formatting and calculation utilities using dayjs. Handles Vietnam timezone (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh), Excel serial date parsing, business day calculations skipping Sundays, and warranty due date logic.

nodes.label: excelHelpers.js
nodes.description: Excel file parsing and row mapping utilities using SheetJS (XLSX). parseExcelFile reads uploaded Excel files, mapExcelRows transforms raw Excel data into warranty record objects with status normalization and date parsing.

nodes.label: fieldLabels.js
nodes.description: Field label resolution utility. Maps internal field keys (e.g., khachHang, maNhanVien) to Vietnamese display labels with safe fallback to the original key.

nodes.label: formatters.js
nodes.description: Formatting utilities: formatVND uses Intl.NumberFormat for Vietnamese Dong currency display, maskName masks personal names for privacy.

nodes.label: generateChungTu.js
nodes.description: Generates sequential document/voucher codes (chung tu) in format DDMMYYYYNBHSC{N} based on today's date and existing codes.

nodes.label: historyDisplay.js
nodes.description: History display normalization. normalizeHistoryNote converts internal field keys and status codes to Vietnamese display text. mapLoaiXuLyValue maps processing type codes to display labels.

nodes.label: historyTimeline.js
nodes.description: History timeline rendering utility. Generates human-readable change descriptions for warranty history entries, mapping field changes to Vietnamese labels.

nodes.label: historyTimeline.js.bak-field-labels
nodes.description: Backup of historyTimeline.js from before i18n field label migration. Retained for reference.

nodes.label: i18nOptions.js
nodes.description: i18n helper utilities. tStatus translates status keys via i18n. makeWarrantyOptions builds localized warranty period and processing type option lists for form dropdowns.

nodes.label: urgency.js
nodes.description: Urgency classification utility. Returns urgency level (done, overdue, urgent, soon, normal) based on warranty status and due date proximity using dayjs.

nodes.description: Unit tests for generateChungTuPreview. Validates correct format generation, sequential incrementing, and ignoring codes from other days.

nodes.label: i18n.test.js
nodes.description: Integration tests for i18n setup. Validates Vietnamese as default language, core namespace loading, interpolation, and i18n-backed constants/validation messages.

nodes.description: Test setup file. Imports @testing-library/jest-dom for DOM matchers used across test suite.

nodes.label: StatusTag.test.jsx

nodes.label: urgency.test.js
nodes.description: Unit tests for getUrgency. Covers done/overdue/urgent/soon/normal urgency levels based on warranty status and due date.

nodes.label: vietnameseUi.test.js
nodes.description: UI tests for Vietnamese text rendering. Validates theme font stack, legacy history text normalization, and shared Vietnamese normalizer for mojibake variants.

nodes.label: vite.config.js

nodes.label: vitest.config.js
nodes.description: Vitest test runner configuration. Uses jsdom environment, enables globals, and references tests/setup.js for test initialization.

nodes.label: web.Dockerfile

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: NTPC Warranty Management System - A full-stack web application for managing computer equipment warranty tickets. Built with React 18, Ant Design, Express.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.

tour.title: Infrastructure Setup
tour.description: Docker Compose orchestrates 4 services: PostgreSQL database, Express.js backend API, Nginx-served React frontend, and Cloudflare Quick Tunnel for public access.

tour.title: Backend API Architecture
tour.description: Express.js server with modular route handlers and library modules. Routes handle REST endpoints while libs provide authentication, database access, audit logging, and backup functionality.

tour.title: Data Model
tour.description: Prisma schema defines the database models for warranties, staff, suppliers, and audit logs. PostgreSQL provides the relational data store.

tour.title: Frontend Entry Point
tour.description: React application bootstraps from main.jsx, renders App.jsx which sets up routing, authentication guards, and lazy-loaded page components.

tour.title: Admin Dashboard
tour.description: Admin pages for managing warranties, viewing statistics, importing/exporting data, and managing staff and suppliers.

tour.title: Customer Portal
tour.description: Public-facing pages for customers to track warranty status by receipt number. Includes tracking results with timeline visualization.

tour.title: Shared Components
tour.description: Reusable UI components including status tags, customer picker modals, warranty history timeline, and theme toggle.

tour.title: Services & Hooks
tour.description: API service clients (warrantyService, backupService) and custom React hooks (useWarranties, useTheme) provide data fetching and state management.

tour.title: Internationalization
tour.description: Vietnamese language support with i18next. Translation files organized by namespace (ui, status, messages, nav, validation, print).

tour.title: Testing
tour.description: Unit tests using Vitest and Testing Library. Tests cover utilities, components, and i18n functionality.
